subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — sizing & $/1M token target
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity follow-up — sizing & $/1M token target

Thanks again for the call this morning, Jordan — good conversation and helped clarify Acme's primary goals. TL;DR: you're prioritizing latency and predictable unit cost for a customer-facing assistant (search/checkout help + returns flow) and exploring Redwood Dedicated as the path to predictable economics.

Quick recap of what I captured from the call:
- Workloads: 3 main features (assistant, checkout helper, returns bot).
- Traffic shape: peak concurrent sessions ~120 (spiky around promo windows), avg session = ~800 tokens (prompt + response), average sessions/day ~50k (rough estimate from your team).
- SLOs: p95 latency target < 400ms for streaming responses where possible.
- Procurement: 8–12 week procurement window; goal to pilot in July.

To get you a concrete Dedicated proposal and a $/1M tokens estimate I need confirmation on a few items below — short bullets are fine:
1) Preferred GPU family (if you have infra constraints): H100 (if you want higher perf) vs A100 40GB vs A10G. Any preference?
2) Expected sustained throughput target (tokens/sec) per model or an example QPS we should size for at peak (e.g., 120 concurrent sessions * avg tokens/sec per session).
3) Monthly token volume target you'd like to budget for (or range). If you're not sure, a target $/1M tokens that you want us to hit helps (you mentioned ~$800/1M as a target — confirm?).
4) Any hard constraints on burst/availability (e.g., must support 2x baseline bursts for 15 minutes).

If helpful I can do a quick sizing calc and show two price points: conservative reserved SKU (lower capex, higher unit cost) and high-utilization committed pricing (lower $/1M). Next steps: once you confirm the bullets above I'll circulate a short Dedicated proposal + sample SOW and a POC plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acmeretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@acmeretail.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up — sizing & $/1M token target

Marissa — thanks for the summary, that's right on. Answers below:
1) GPU: we prefer A100 40GB for cost & compatibility across our infra team. H100 would be ideal for headroom but procurement is tougher on that SKU.
2) Throughput: peak concurrent sessions = 120. Each session averages 800 tokens but those come in bursts (prompt then streaming responses). Target peak sustained throughput to support peak = ~20,000 tokens/sec (this accounts for concurrent sessions + a 1.5x buffer).
3) Monthly tokens: conservative forecast for pilot/first 3 months = 500M tokens/month; target production volume 1.5B tokens/month over next 12 months. For procurement I want to budget ~$700–$900 / 1M tokens. If you can get into that range with a committed reserved plan, that's attractive.
4) Burst requirement: must be able to handle 2x baseline for at least 10–15 minutes during promotions (we'd expect Redwood to support burst via short-term autoscale or overflow routing).

Procurement timeline: POC in July, production by late Q3. Please send sizing + pricing and a short SOW.

—
Jordan Miles
Head of Product — Conversational Experience
Acme Retail
jordan.miles@acmeretail.com | (617) 555-0128

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up — sizing & $/1M token target

Appreciate the details, Jordan — very helpful. Based on A100-40GB preference and your traffic profile here's an initial sizing + rough unit-econ snapshot (quick working numbers we can refine):

Sizing (initial):
- Reserved pool: 4x A100-40GB (reserved). Rationale: supports ~20k tokens/sec sustained with room for batching/streaming; suitable for ~500M tokens/month steady state with spikes covered via brief autoscale or routing to Redwood Hosted fallback.
- If you want to target 1.5B tokens/month sustained, we'd recommend 10x A100-40GB or moving to H100 family for denser throughput.

Unit economics example (illustrative):
- Option A (4x A100 reserved): estimated monthly platform + infra cost to Redwood = $32,000 (HW amortized + infra ops + SW). At forecast 500M tokens/month => cost per 1M tokens = $64 (this is internal cost placeholder; final customer price will include margin + support/SLAs).
- Customer list price (example tier): with reserved discount and a 12-month commit, target customer price could be in the ballpark of $700–$900 / 1M tokens for 500M+ volumes. That aligns with your $700–$900 target.

Important: the $/1M token number is highly sensitive to utilization and burst strategy. Example: with utilization >60% the effective $/1M drops materially; with heavy burst and low utilization the $/1M increases. We'll show two scenarios in the formal proposal: POC/low-utilization and committed-high-utilization.

POC recommendation:
- 4x A100 reserved for 6 weeks POC (covering functional validation and 2 promotional spikes).
- POC success metric: sustain 20k tokens/sec at p95 latency < 400ms and achieve median unit cost < $950 / 1M tokens across the POC window with production-like traffic generator.

I'll attach a pricing sheet and a draft SOW for procurement to review. Can we schedule a 30-min call Friday to walk the numbers and confirm procurement path?

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acmeretail.com>

Sounds good — 4x A100 for the POC works for us. Friday 10:00am PT for a numbers walk-through works. We want the pricing sheet + SOW before the call so procurement can start reviewing. Also please include a short section on how Redwood handles short bursts (autoscale/fallback) and expected failover behavior.

I'll loop procurement on the HubSpot deal and share internal SOW comments after your doc.

—
Jordan

Jordan — attaching the Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_Sheet_v2.pdf and draft SOW (SOW-draft.docx) per your request. Highlights in the pricing sheet: two recommended configs (4x A100 POC and 10x A100 committed), estimated $/1M tokens at the volumes you provided, and burst handling (short-term autoscale + overflow to Hosted API).

Next steps:
1) Review attachments with procurement.
2) Friday 10:00am PT: 30-min call to walk numbers (calendar invite to follow).
3) If procurement has redlines, we can circulate an updated SOW within 48 hours.

Let me know if you'd prefer we size a 6x A100 option as a middle ground; we can include that alternative in the Friday deck.
